Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 32

“I desire neither victory, Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures. What is kingdom to us, Govinda, what enjoyments, or even life itself?”

Arjuna renounces the war's entire prize list in one breath, then goes further and questions the value of living at all. The escalation from kingdom to life happens very fast.
